verdict.rationale: Convex's own docs list built-in file storage "for large objects" as a product feature, included on the Free/Starter tier, so the core storage capability exists. The pack has no detail on how uploads work, how files are served, or whether files sit behind access rules or a CDN. The code-defined authorization claims are about functions generally, not files specifically. Missing for 10: documented upload and serving workflow, file-specific access-control rules, CDN-backed delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.
